scope: termux package builder, runtime authority and physical promotion gates

fato: the termux-packages fork is no longer empty
PR #4 consumes and validates the binary manifest before package execution
PR #331 preserves upstream as production reference and the fork as experimental builder
RLL software/governance integration has a 924-test and 7-workflow receipt
lacuna: NDK 26.3.11579264 is not installed on the verified host
ARMv7 and AArch64 physical package receipts do not exist
source fetching and SHA-256 verification are not implemented in the experimental builder
patch execution and dependency closure are incomplete
TAR versus deb/apt/dpkg distribution authority is undecided
invariante: upstream production reference cannot be silently replaced
experimental progress cannot bypass toolchain and device receipts
every promotion must point to source, toolchain, package hash, installation, execution and rollback
variante: retain upstream as source while using fork only as experimental compiler
promote individual packages after per-ABI receipts rather than promoting the whole fork
introduce a manifest v2 if the v1 dependency bound cannot represent the corpus losslessly
prova_falsificador: manifest malformed or package missing must stop before build
empty prefix must block package creation
device install or rollback failure must block release
seven_directions.parabola: The upstream is the public road; the fork is the experimental bridge. The bridge may be promising, but traffic is not diverted until its pillars are tested on both banks.
